```{r}
source("SMT_Data_starter.R")
library(broom)
```

```{r}
lineups<-filter(lineups,inning<=8)
# A few lineups have batters be NA, this fixes that.
for (i in seq(1,nrow(lineups)-1)){
  if(is.na(lineups[i+1,"batter"])){
    if(lineups[i+1,"at_bat"]==lineups[i,"at_bat"]){
      lineups[i+1,"batter"]=lineups[i,"batter"]
    }
  }
}
```
```{r}
# To determine outs, start by grouping plays based on base state.
ball_events_data=ball_events%>%
  filter(!is.na(game_string))%>%
  collect()
lineups$outs=0
lineups<-lineups%>%
  group_by(game_string,inning,half_inning,batter,on_1b,on_2b,on_3b)%>%
  filter(play_per_game==max(play_per_game)&game_string%in%ball_events_data$game_string)%>%
  ungroup()
for (i in seq(1,nrow(lineups))){
  out=FALSE
  if(i==nrow(lineups)) lineups[[i,"outs"]]=2
  # We know if the half-inning or game changes, the first one will have 0 outs
  else if(lineups[[i,"half_inning"]]!=lineups[[i+1,"half_inning"]]|lineups[[i,"game_string"]]!=lineups[[i+1,"game_string"]]) {
    lineups[[i+1,"outs"]]=0
    next}
  # If there is a pickoff, and a player on base disappears, we assume there was an out.
  else if (lineups[i,"is_pickoff"]==TRUE&(!lineups[i,"on_1b"]%in%c(lineups[i+1,"on_1b"],lineups[i+1,"on_2b"],lineups[i+1,"on_3b"])|!lineups[i+1,"on_2b"]%in%c(lineups[i+1,"on_2b"],lineups[i+1,"on_3b"]))){
    lineups[[i+1,"outs"]]=lineups[[i+1,"outs"]]+1
  }
  else{
    # Now if there is a home run, then we know there were no outs
    play=ball_events_data%>%filter(game_string==lineups[[i,"game_string"]]&play_per_game==lineups[[i,"play_per_game"]])
    if(11%in%play$ball_eventcode){
      lineups[[i+1,"outs"]]=lineups[[i,"outs"]]
      next
    }
    # If the batter does not appear on base and there wasn't a home run, I assume there is an out
    else if (lineups[[i,"batter"]]!=lineups[[i+1,"batter"]]&(!lineups[i,"batter"]%in%c(lineups[i+1,"on_1b"],lineups[i+1,"on_2b"],lineups[i+1,"on_3b"]))){
      lineups[[i+1,"outs"]]=lineups[[i,"outs"]]+1
      out<-TRUE
    }
    else{
      lineups[[i+1,"outs"]]=lineups[[i,"outs"]]
    }
  }
  # I'm assuming on an out, no one is scoring from first or second, so if a player disappears, then I assume it's a double play
  if(out==TRUE &(!lineups[i,"on_1b"]%in%c(lineups[i+1,"on_1b"],lineups[i+1,"on_2b"],lineups[i+1,"on_3b"]))){
    lineups[[i+1,"outs"]]=lineups[[i+1,"outs"]]+1
  }
  if(out==TRUE &(!lineups[i,"on_2b"]%in%c(lineups[i+1,"on_2b"],lineups[i+1,"on_3b"]))&!is.na(lineups[i,"on_2b"])){
    lineups[[i+1,"outs"]]=lineups[[i+1,"outs"]]+1
  }
}
# Using full_data for Sniper metric calculation
full_data<-lineups
full_data$play_game_id<-paste0(full_data$game_string,full_data$play_per_game)
```

```{r}
# Now filter out sac flies only to determine what plays to look at.
# Add play_game_id to make it easier to filter through specific plays.
lineups<-lineups%>%filter(!is.na(on_3b)&outs<2)

lineups$play_game_id<-paste0(lineups$game_string,lineups$play_per_game)

ball_events_data<-ball_events_data%>%
  mutate(play_game_id=paste0(game_string,play_per_game))%>%
  filter(play_game_id%in%full_data$play_game_id)

ball_positions_data=ball_positions%>%
  mutate(play_game_id=paste0(game_string,play_per_game))%>%
  filter(play_game_id%in%full_data$play_game_id)%>%
  collect()

player_positions_data<-player_positions%>%
  mutate(play_game_id=paste0(game_string,play_per_game))%>%
  filter(play_game_id%in%lineups$play_game_id)%>%
  collect()
```

```{r}
# Get distance for key throws to home
ball_events_throws <- ball_events_data %>%
  group_by(game_string, play_per_game) %>%
  filter(((player_id == 7|player_id == 9|player_id == 8) & ball_eventcode == 3 & 
  ((lead(player_id) == 2 & lead(ball_eventcode) == 2)|(lead(ball_eventcode)==16&lead(player_id,2) == 2 & lead(ball_eventcode,2) == 2)))) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(game_string, play_per_game, player_id, ball_eventcode, throw_timestamp =timestamp,play_game_id)
```
```{r}
# Get catches for those throws
ball_events_catch <- ball_events_data %>%
# I removed two catches that was caused by multiple throws to home on the same play, with the second one in both situations not being by an outfielder.
  filter(player_id==2&ball_eventcode==2&play_game_id%in%ball_events_throws$play_game_id&timestamp!=8251948&timestamp!=4322623)%>%
  select(game_string, play_per_game, player_id, ball_eventcode, catch_timestamp = timestamp,play_game_id)
```
```{r}
# Figure out what player threw and caught the ball using ball_events_throws
ball_events_throws$fielding_id<-" "
ball_events_catch$catch_id<-" "
ball_events_throws$on_first<-0
ball_events_throws$on_second<-0
for(i in seq(1:nrow(ball_events_throws))){
  key_row<-full_data%>%
    filter(play_game_id==ball_events_throws[[i,"play_game_id"]])
  if(nrow(key_row)==0) next
  if(ball_events_throws[[i,"player_id"]]==7){
    ball_events_throws[i,"fielding_id"]=key_row[1,"left_fielder"]
  }
  if(ball_events_throws[[i,"player_id"]]==8){
    ball_events_throws[i,"fielding_id"]=key_row[1,"center_fielder"]
  }
  if(ball_events_throws[[i,"player_id"]]==9){
    ball_events_throws[i,"fielding_id"]=key_row[1,"right_fielder"]
  }
  if(!is.na(key_row[i,"on_1b"])){
    ball_events_throws[i,"on_first"]=1
  }
  if(!is.na(key_row[i,"on_2b"])){
    ball_events_throws[i,"on_second"]=1
  }
}

for(i in seq(1:nrow(ball_events_catch))){
  key_row<-full_data%>%
    filter(play_per_game==ball_events_catch[[i,"play_per_game"]]&game_string==ball_events_catch[[i,"game_string"]])
  if(nrow(key_row)==0) next
  ball_events_catch[i,"catch_id"]=key_row[1,"catcher"]

}

  
```


```{r}
# Get the ball location data for the plays we need
ball_locations<- ball_positions_data%>%
  filter(
  (play_game_id%in%ball_events_throws$play_game_id))%>%
  select(-c(home_team, away_team, year, day))
for (i in seq(1,nrow(ball_events_throws))){
  key_row_One<-ball_events_throws[i,]
  key_row_Two<-filter(ball_events_catch,play_game_id==key_row_One$play_game_id)
  ball_locations<-ball_locations%>%
    filter(!(play_game_id==key_row_One$play_game_id&(timestamp>key_row_Two$catch_timestamp|timestamp<key_row_One$throw_timestamp)))
}
```

```{r}
# Get the distance thrown
dthrown <- ball_locations %>%
  # Convert ball_position coordinates to numeric
  mutate(ball_position_x = as.numeric(ball_position_x),
         ball_position_y = as.numeric(ball_position_y),
         ball_position_z = as.numeric(ball_position_z),
         timestamp=as.numeric(timestamp)) %>%
  # Group by play
  group_by(game_string, play_per_game) %>%
    # Find change_x, change_y and change_time and distance traveled
    mutate(change_x = ball_position_x - lag(ball_position_x),
           change_y = ball_position_y - lag(ball_position_y),
           change_z = ball_position_z - lag(ball_position_z),
           # Find front corner and use this for dist_off_plate
           dist_off_plate=sqrt((ball_position_x+8.5/12)^2+(ball_position_y-17/12)^2),
           change_time_ms = timestamp - lag(timestamp),
           # Convert change_time_ms to seconds
           change_time_sec = change_time_ms / 1000,
           distance_thrown = sqrt(change_x^2 + change_y^2+change_z^2),
           # Get velocity for Sniper calculation
           velo=(distance_thrown+lag(distance_thrown))/(change_time_sec+lag(change_time_sec)),
           total_distance_thrown=sum(distance_thrown,na.rm=TRUE),
           # We only need max velocity (right after throw)
           max_velo=max(velo,na.rm=TRUE))%>%
          filter(timestamp==max(timestamp))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(distance_thrown=total_distance_thrown,
         velo=max_velo)
# Get which player threw the ball
dthrown$player<-" "
for (i in seq(1,nrow(dthrown))){
  data<-ball_events_throws%>%
  filter(play_game_id==dthrown[[i,"play_game_id"]])
  dthrown[i,"player"]=data$fielding_id
}
```

```{r}
# Time to do running speed in a similar method to throwing speed
runner_positions_data<-player_positions_data%>%
  filter(player_id==13&(timestamp %in% ball_events_catch$catch_timestamp|timestamp %in% ball_events_throws$throw_timestamp)&
  (play_per_game %in% ball_events_catch$play_per_game|play_per_game %in% ball_events_throws$play_per_game)&
    (game_string %in% ball_events_catch$game_string|game_string %in% ball_events_throws$game_string))%>%
  select(-c(home_team, away_team, year, day))

```

```{r}
# Get the runners pace per 90 ft
dran<-runner_positions_data%>%
  mutate(field_x = as.numeric(field_x),
         field_y = as.numeric(field_y),
         timestamp=as.numeric(timestamp)) %>%
  group_by(player_id,play_per_game,game_string)%>%
  mutate(change_x = field_x - lag(field_x),
           change_y = field_y - lag(field_y),
           change_time_ms = timestamp - lag(timestamp),
           # Convert change_time_ms to seconds
           change_time_sec = change_time_ms / 1000,
           distance_ran = sqrt(change_x^2 + change_y^2))%>%
          ungroup()%>%
  filter(!is.na(change_time_sec))
  
dran$player<-" "
dran$sac_fly=0
for (i in seq(1,nrow(dran))){
  key_row<-lineups%>%
    filter(play_per_game==dran[[i,"play_per_game"]]&game_string==dran[[i,"game_string"]])
  dran[i,"player"]=key_row[1,"on_3b"]
  # This checks to see if at the moment the catcher catchers the ball, whether the runner passed home
  if(dran[[i,"field_x"]]<=-8.5/12&dran[[i,"field_y"]]>=17/12){
    dran[i,"sac_fly"]=1
  }
}
# Calculate the runners pace per ninety feet
dran<-dran%>%
  mutate(pace_per_ninety=(change_time_sec/distance_ran)*90)
dran_test<-dran%>%
  group_by(player)%>%
  mutate(min_pace=quantile(pace_per_ninety,.9))%>%
  filter(pace_per_ninety>=min_pace)%>%
  mutate(speed=mean(pace_per_ninety))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  distinct(player,speed)%>%
  #removed player due to having extreme outlier (pace of 279)
  filter(player!="ARN-9747")

for (i in seq(1,nrow(dran))){
  key<-dran_test%>%
    filter(player==dran[[i,"player"]])
  dran[i,"pace_per_ninety"]=key[1,"speed"]
}
# From here only look at thrown plays that are sacrifice flies.
dthrown_sac<-dthrown%>%
  filter(paste0(play_game_id,timestamp)%in%paste0(dran$play_game_id,dran$timestamp))
```

```{r}
# Time to build Sniper metric
Sniper_data<-dthrown%>%
  group_by(player)%>%
  # Only use throws where 90th percentile for velo
  mutate(min_power=quantile(velo,0.9))%>%
  filter(velo>=min_power)%>%
  mutate(Power=mean(velo),Accuracy=mean(dist_off_plate))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  # Center and scale the data
  mutate(Power=scale(Power),Accuracy=scale(Accuracy))%>%
  distinct()%>%
  select(player,Power,Accuracy)
pca_data<-Sniper_data%>%
  select(Power,Accuracy)

# Use PCA to get the coefficients in one dimension
pca<-prcomp(pca_data)
summary(pca)
coeff<-pca$rotation
PowerC<-coeff["Power","PC1"]
AccuracyC<-coeff["Accuracy","PC1"]
Sniper_data<-Sniper_data%>%
  mutate(Sniper=Power*PowerC+Accuracy*AccuracyC)
```

```{r}
# Assign Sniper metric to each players throws
dthrown_sac$sniper<-0
for (i in seq(1,nrow(dthrown_sac))){
  key<-Sniper_data%>%
    filter(player==dthrown_sac[[i,"player"]])
  dthrown_sac[i,"sniper"]=key[1,"Power"]*PowerC+key[1,"Accuracy"]*AccuracyC
}
# Join dran and dthrown_sac to get all metrics needed
model_data<-left_join(dran,dthrown_sac,by=c("play_game_id","timestamp"))

model_data<-model_data%>%  
  select(sac_fly,sniper,distance_thrown,pace_per_ninety,dist_off_plate)
# Use logistic regression to get the model coefficients
primary_model<-glm(sac_fly~sniper+distance_thrown+pace_per_ninety, data=model_data,family=binomial)
summary(primary_model)
values<-primary_model$coefficients
# Saved as csv to be used by the Shiny app
write.csv(dran_test,"dran_values.csv")
write.csv(Sniper_data,"sniper_data.csv")
write.csv(values,"model_coefficients.csv")

parameters<-tidy(primary_model)
write.csv(parameters,"model_summary.csv")
```
